preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 2013.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 2013 for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Length of each string S is between 1 and 2013.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ?' for c in S) for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Each character in S is either a capital letter from 'A' to 'Z' or a question mark '?'

postconditions.description: The number of output strings matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in output) for output in output_list)
postconditions.description: Each output string contains only capital letters from 'A' to 'Z'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == len(S) for output, S in zip(output_list, S_list))
postconditions.description: Each output string has the same length as the corresponding input string.

postconditions.expression: all(output <= other_output for output, other_output in zip(output_list, sorted(output_list)))
postconditions.description: Each output string is lexicographically smaller than or equal to the next one.

postconditions.expression: all(max_chefs(output) >= max_chefs(other_output) for output, other_output in zip(output_list, output_list))
postconditions.description: Each output string contains at least as many 'CHEF' substrings as any other string with the same input.
